No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

In this lecture you explain what one ancient genome can and cannot establish.

Length, level and language are agreed with you. The lecture can be given online or at your venue, for a single class, a department or a whole organisation.

What it covers

  • What aDNA can say
  • Rakhigarhi 2019 paper
  • Interpretation boundaries

How the time is spent

  1. What aDNA can say 20 min

    Sampling limits, contamination, population models.

    You: method diagram

  2. Rakhigarhi 2019 paper 45 min

    Single-genome limits and methodological caveats.

    You: evidence critique

  3. Interpretation boundaries 25 min

    Distinguish ancestry statistics from identity claims.

    You: critical response

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Explain what ancient DNA can show, given sampling limits, contamination and population models.
  • Assess the limits of the single genome reported in the 2019 Rakhigarhi paper.
  • Distinguish ancestry statistics from claims about identity in debates on the Harappans.
